definitions.explanation: The group, within a party or in politics generally, that favors keeping traditions and existing institutions.

examples.japanese: {保守派|ほしゅは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧。
{保守派|ほしゅは}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}している→反対する：05648_hantaisuru⟧。
⟦{党内|とうない}→党内：31645_tounai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保守派|ほしゅは}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{改革派|かいかくは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{深|ふか}まっている→深まる：02406_fukamaru⟧。
examples.english: The conflict between the conservatives and the reformers within the party is deepening.

notes:
⟦{保守|ほしゅ}→保守：19090_hoshu⟧ (conservatism) + 〜⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ (faction). The opposite is {革新派|かくしんは} (progressives) or {改革派|かいかくは} (reformers), depending on the context.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {保守派|ほしゅは}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{議員|ぎいん}→議員：02660_giin⟧: a conservative legislator
- ⟦{党内|とうない}→党内：31645_tounai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{保守派|ほしゅは}: the conservative wing of a party

USAGE:
〜⟦{派|は}→派：28356_ha⟧ makes a word for a faction or camp: {改革派|かいかくは} (reformers), {穏健派|おんけんは} (moderates), {強硬派|きょうこうは} (hardliners), and casually {犬派|いぬは} / {猫派|ねこは} "a dog person / a cat person."
